per_question.question: What are Amazon Bedrock Agents?
per_question.ground_truth: Amazon Bedrock Agents are fully managed capabilities that make it easier for developers to create generative AI–based applications that can complete complex tasks for a wide range of use cases and deliver up-to-date answers based on proprietary knowledge sources.
